entityType.description: entity type name in current release

oldEntityType.description: entity type name in previous release; if not set then new type will be used instead

isPrimary.description: if this is a primary type mapping for oldEntityType

oldFieldPath.description: arry or map field name in the old entity type; this is only used when new entity type is migrated from an old array or map

whereSql.description: custom sql where clause to add to source entry type query

fieldMigrations.description: configuration for generating data migration sql for fields

afterSqlProcName.description:
optional name of the sql stored procedure that will be invoked for every old record after

they have been successfully migrated; proc should have 2 IN param: appCode and srcId;

title: configuration for generating data migration sql for a single entity type
name: EntityDataMigration
